title: Ajjhatta (tayo)
text: 3-8 Cakkhum bhikkhave aniccaṃ || || Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || Jivhā || Kāyo || Mano anicco || || 9 Evam passam || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pājānātīti || || (56) Ajjhatta2 3-8 Cakkhum bhikkhave dukkhaṃ || Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhā || || Kāyo || || Mano dukkho || || 9 Evam passam || pe || nāparam itthattāyati pajānātīti || || [page 156] 156 SAḶĀYATANA-SAṂYUTTA [XXXV. 185. 3. 3 (57) Ajjhatta3 3-8 Cakkhum bhikkhave anattā || || Sotaṃ || || Ghānaṃ || || Jivhā || || Kāyo || || Mano dukkho || || 9 Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyati pajānātīti || ||
